angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 736,746 km at 94.14 pc = 0.1 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.6224 +/- 0.0121 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 94.14 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.059 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Murphy et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 219666 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..286M/abstract): 736,746 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.02 +/- 0.1 solar masses from Murphy et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 219666 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..286M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5540 +/- 63 K from Murphy et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 219666 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..286M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Murphy et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 219666 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..286M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-219666.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.397, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 219666 (pscomppars): spectral type G5 V, from Oddo et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..134O/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 219666 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.04 dex, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 219666 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.0278, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 219666 (pscomppars): age 10 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 219666 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.2 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
